If your order or product doesn’t work out for you, you generally have these options:

Return within 30 days: All customers have a voluntary 30‑day return right from receipt, as long as items are unused, complete, and in original packaging.
EU/UK withdrawal right: You also have a 14‑day statutory withdrawal right; registering a return in the Return Portal counts as your withdrawal, then you have another 14 days to hand the parcel to the carrier.
No direct exchanges: We don’t offer direct exchanges; instead:
Register a return via our 👉 Return Portal
Send the item back
Place a new order for the item you’d prefer
After 30 days: If the 30‑day period has passed but your item is completely unused and in original packaging, in individual cases an exception may still be possible; our Customer Care Team will review what’s feasible.
